stage2_results.local_context:
After the fee plan was withdrawn and replaced, Brent crude oil futures briefly lost some of their gains. Prices seemed ready to fall. But they soon returned to a high level near their earlier level. At the time of reporting, they were up about 2.6 percent, above 85 dollars a barrel.

Oil prices did not fall across the whole market after the plan was withdrawn. At the same time, attacks by the United States and Iran continued. So did a sea blockade and worries about tanker safety.

The fee plan disappeared. But news about tensions around the strait stayed on stage. Political statements changed greatly. Oil prices moved briefly, then returned to a high level. The interesting point this time was simple. One headline alone could not decide how the story would end.
